welcome.title: Services Coeliaque: your gluten-free tools in one place.
welcome.subtitle: Calculate your tax credit, manage your grocery lists and connect with the community — even when you’re offline.
welcome.loggedInSubtitle: Your invoices, grocery lists, and community discussions are at your disposal whenever you are.
welcome.loggedInNoMembershipSubtitle: To unlock tax reports, grocery lists and all features, you’ll first need to activate your membership.

hero.offlineHint: Works offline: keep using your invoices, price comparisons, grocery lists and more even without an internet connection.

calculator.title: Calculate your tax deduction
calculator.body: Centralize your gluten-free invoices, mark eligible purchases and generate reports designed for your accountant.

grocery.title: Manage your grocery lists
grocery.body: Build and reuse grocery lists, check items off on your phone in store and avoid forgetting essentials.

community.title: Join the community forum
community.body: Ask questions, share tips and exchange ideas with others living with celiac disease.

story.title: Why this site exists
story.intro: This project began with a simple situation: someone close to me explained how time-consuming and repetitive it was to prepare the comparison sheets and reports needed for celiac tax refunds.

points.personal: They asked if I could build a small tool to make the process easier — something that would avoid spending hours sorting invoices and redoing the same calculations.
points.paperwork: I created the first version, and it quickly saved a lot of time. That’s when I realized they were probably not the only person struggling with this task.
points.prototype: So I turned the little tool into a proper website so more people could benefit from it. I improved the interface, added faster comparison workflows, and made report preparation much more straightforward.
points.today: Over time, new ideas were added: a mobile-friendly version, grocery lists, offline mode to keep using your data without an internet connection, and other practical features. Today, this site exists to make life easier for anyone living with celiac disease.

installCard.title: Install Services Coeliaque on your device
installCard.intro: Add the site to your home screen or app menu for faster access and an optimized experience.

ios.title: On iPhone / iPad (Safari):
ios.step2: Tap the Share button (a square with an upward arrow).
ios.step3: Scroll and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
ios.step4: Confirm the name if needed, then tap “Add”.

android.title: On Android (Chrome):
android.step1: Open the site in Google Chrome.
android.step2: Tap the menu (⋮) in the top-right corner.
android.step3: Choose “Add to Home screen”, then “Install” if prompted.
android.step4: The icon will appear on your home screen like an app.

chromeDesktop.title: On desktop (Google Chrome):
chromeDesktop.step2: If an “Install” icon appears in the address bar, click it and choose “Install”.
chromeDesktop.step3: If you don’t see an icon, open the menu (⋮) > “Cast, save and share” > “Install page as app”.
chromeDesktop.step4: The app will be available in your Start menu and/or Dock like a native application.

edgeDesktop.title: On desktop (Microsoft Edge):
edgeDesktop.step1: Open the site in Microsoft Edge.
edgeDesktop.step2: Click the menu (⋯) in the top-right corner.
edgeDesktop.step3: Go to “Extra tools” / “More tools” if present, then “Apps”.
edgeDesktop.step4: Choose “Install this site as an app” or “Install ‘Services Coeliaque’”.

safariDesktop.title: On macOS (Safari, macOS Sonoma or later):
safariDesktop.step2: In the menu bar, choose “File” > “Add to Dock”.
safariDesktop.step3: Or use the Share button and select “Add to Dock”.
safariDesktop.step4: The icon will appear in the Dock as a dedicated app.

firefoxDesktop.title: On desktop (Firefox):
firefoxDesktop.body1: Firefox supports some PWA features but does not always offer full installation like Chrome or Edge.
firefoxDesktop.body2: You can still create a shortcut to the site (for example, in your Dock or taskbar) using your system tools or browser bookmarks.

otherDesktop.title: On desktop (other browsers):
otherDesktop.body: On most modern desktop browsers, an install button may appear in the address bar, or an “Install” / “Apps” option may be available in the browser menu.

otherMobile.title: On mobile (other browsers):
otherMobile.body: In many mobile browsers, the option “Add to Home screen” or “Install app” is available in the browser menu (⋮ or ☰).
